author: Noema III
title: DSConv-PM v4 — Dataset-aware reverse handling (disable on CRI-Off; train-off on ncRNA)
abstract: Same compact DSConv + power-mean model, but toggles reverse augmentation/bi-reverse evaluation per dataset: OFF for CRI-Off (orientation-sensitive), train-reverse OFF but eval averaging ON for ncRNA; both ON for APA/PRS/MRL/Modif/CRI-On.
